I take extra time shaving and trimming my beard before I leave. It makes me feel prepared for the day. What do you think?

It's great that you've found a morning routine that helps you feel prepared and confident for the day. Taking extra time to shave and trim your beard can be a therapeutic and meditative experience, allowing you to focus on yourself and set a positive tone for the day ahead. Having a well-groomed beard can also boost your self-esteem and make you feel more put together, which can translate to other areas of your life. It's almost like a ritual that signals to yourself that you're ready to take on the day. It's also interesting that you mention feeling "prepared" for the day. This suggests that your morning grooming routine is not just about physical appearance, but also about mental preparation. By taking care of your physical appearance, you're also taking care of your mental state, which can help you feel more focused and ready to tackle challenges. Overall, it's wonderful that you've found a routine that works for you and helps you feel your best. Keep enjoying that extra time in the morning, and remember that it's okay to prioritize self-care and take a few extra minutes to get ready – it's an investment in your own well-being!
